text:
I'm sorry your delivery was two weeks late. That's a frustrating experience, and I understand why you're upset.

I can offer a one-time goodwill store credit of up to $15 myself. A $200 credit is beyond what I can approve, and it's over the $150 threshold that needs a Support Lead. Since you're asking for something outside policy, I'll escalate this to a Support Lead for review. Would you like me to do that, and would you also like the $15 credit applied in the meantime?

To help the Support Lead, please send your order number. I can't give you a timeframe for their response, as our policy doesn't specify one for escalations.
